answer: Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the dawn queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1896 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the willow. The zenith index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
